_comment: Cold runs of every honest reference through check.py, in CPU SECONDS: `stages.solution.cpu_seconds` (the compile of the reference's Solution.lean, nothing else), with the wall clock of the same run (`stages.solution.seconds`) beside it. The input of score/time_limits.py, which holds every task to the one limit of 300 CPU s (decided 2026-11-02, the value 2026-11-06; it was 120 s of wall clock), names every reference above the 150 CPU s target, and fails when a measurement is not in CPU seconds or a reference task.json lists has none. T = the largest CPU run of the slowest reference of the task. Re-measured 2026-11-06 because the runs recorded before (2026-10-30 to 2026-11-05) were wall-clock seconds, which the CPU limit does not count (they are in this file's history). Re-measure after a change of the tactic library, the toolchain or the machine: put the new runs here and run `python3 score/time_limits.py --check`. Not hashed by the checker.

environment.machine: Apple M2 Pro (8 performance and 4 efficiency cores), 16 GB, macOS 27.2: a laptop-class development machine, shared: other users' jobs ran throughout (1-minute load average 2.8 to 13.2 when the runs started); nothing else of this package ran concurrently; which cores ran a process was not controlled
environment.build: COLD per run: a new check.py process and a fresh staging directory (--stage-dir, removed before and after) for every run, the references of one task in sequence inside one acquisition of the Lean slot wrapper (one task per acquisition), 3 sweeps of all tasks one after the other; the project build (svGolf, tasks, LeanModels.Sv) was warm and current, not timed; the OS file cache was not purged
environment.threads: LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 and nice 19 (the slot wrapper); the CPU seconds count both threads
environment.lean_cache: svGolf and LeanModels.Sv .olean files built and current, the staged Submission/*.olean built from scratch inside each run; lean-toolchain leanprover/lean4:v4.33.0-rc1
environment.postsynth_mode: none: --no-score (no score, no post-synthesis; neither enters the solution stage)
environment.reference_commit: sweep 1: 96459073f; sweep 2: bddf0f84e, 2fc47cb87; sweep 3: 2fc47cb87 (no commit between them changes the references, svGolf, LeanModels or the solution stage); arbiter, matmul and sorter: 5a9c89290, all three sweeps (the merge round that brought the arbiter and the txtask-v2 proofs of matmul_g1 and sorter_ins)
environment.measured_with: check.py tasks/<task> tasks/<task>/reference/<stem>.sv tasks/<task>/reference/<stem>.lean --no-score --stage-dir <fresh> --json <out>, default sandbox (auto: on)
